subject.title: feat(ui): create catalog sessions from the sidebar

question: Should session catalogs gain a public declarative creation capability that can select a provider-owned model in the core new-session flow?
rationale: This creates a permanent plugin SDK and gateway protocol surface tied to provider routing; code review can require safe binding, but only maintainers can confirm that this is the intended ownership boundary and long-term API.

options.title: Approve bound catalog creation
options.body: Keep the additive capability, but route by catalog id and revalidate the currently advertised target before session creation.

options.title: Keep creation core-owned
options.body: Limit this PR to agent-scoped sidebar creation and deduplication while leaving provider and model selection in existing core new-session controls.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Land no catalog creation API until a narrower protocol and plugin contract proposal is approved.

recommendation.title: Approve bound catalog creation
recommendation.body: Keep the additive capability, but route by catalog id and revalidate the currently advertised target before session creation.

likelyOwner.reason: The gateway session and targeting history makes this the strongest available owner for the cross-client session creation contract.
